verdict.rationale: Raygun documents API access only for narrow tasks: the Deployments API, dSYM, ProGuard and JavaScript/source-map uploads via an external access token. It also has an official MCP server, which implies some programmatic access. Nothing shows that core UI workflows such as triage statuses, ignore rules, filtering, exports, settings or AI resolution are available through an API, and no OpenAPI spec could be found. Missing for 10: documented API coverage of error-status/triage management, settings, export and search; a published OpenAPI/reference spec; evidence of UI–API parity; independent corroboration.
